sources.entry: QuickLook Video - This package allows macOS Finder to display thumbnails, static QuickLook previews, cover art and metadata for most types of video files.

summary.one_liner: QLVideo is a macOS add-on that makes Finder thumbnails, Quick Look previews, and Get Info metadata work for many video and audio formats that macOS does not natively handle.
summary.what_it_does: The app adds support for non-native media file types in macOS, including Matroska (.mkv, .mka), WebM, Windows Media (.wma, .wmv), Ogg Video, AVI, QuickTime (.mov), Flash Video, Real Media, MXF and GXF. It covers a wide range of codecs, including VP8, VP9, AV1, HEVC/H.265, VVC/H.266, Theora, Cinepak, DivX and Intel Indeo, plus audio codecs such as Vorbis, WavPack and ATRAC. It works through a Spotlight extension, which handles thumbnails, previews and metadata in Finder, and two Media Extensions, which add playback support to AVFoundation. The README describes it as a successor in spirit to Perian, which served the same role under QuickTime.
use_cases: see video thumbnails in Finder for mkv or webm files
Quick Look preview of non-native video formats on Mac
view metadata of AVI, WMV or FLV files in Get Info
play MKV, WebM or AV1 video in macOS apps via Media Extensions
browse a folder of mixed video archives with proper thumbnails
how_to_run: See the Getting Started guide linked in the README
notable: Covers many container formats and codecs that native macOS QuickLook and Spotlight cannot read
Uses a Spotlight extension for Finder thumbnails and metadata plus Media Extensions for AVFoundation playback
Successor in spirit to Perian, which worked with the older QuickTime framework
Includes a troubleshooting guide in the project documentation
caveats: Targets macOS only; the README describes only Mac components
Installation and usage details are behind a linked Getting Started page, not in the README itself
